BRAKE SYSTEM – ANTI–LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS)

INSPECTION PROCEDURE

Check voltage between terminal 1 of R/B No. 5 (for TRAC motor relay)
and body ground.

LOCK

C  Measure voltage between terminal 1 of R/B No. 5
(for TRAC motor relay) and body ground.

OK  Voltage: 10 — 14 V.

pump motor.
